duas.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ
duas.english: We have entered the morning and the dominion belongs to Allah. All praise is for Allah. There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner.
duas.benefit: Acknowledges Allah's sovereignty at the start of the day and is a powerful protection against shirk.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
duas.english: O Allah, by You we enter the morning and the evening, by You we live and die, and to You is the resurrection.
duas.benefit: A reminder that every breath of the day depends on Allah.

duas.arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
duas.english: Allah is sufficient for me. There is no god but Him. Upon Him I rely, and He is the Lord of the Mighty Throne.
duas.benefit: Whoever recites this seven times morning and evening, Allah will suffice him for whatever worries him.

duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
duas.english: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on earth or in the heavens can cause harm. He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
duas.benefit: Whoever says this three times will not be afflicted by any sudden calamity until evening.

duas.arabic: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
duas.english: We have entered the evening and the dominion belongs to Allah. All praise is for Allah.
duas.benefit: An evening counterpart to the morning remembrance — affirms Allah's dominion.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَمْسَى بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ
duas.english: O Allah, whatever blessing has come to me or any of Your creation this evening is from You alone, with no partner.
duas.benefit: Whoever says this in the evening has fulfilled the gratitude due that night.

duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
duas.english: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.
duas.benefit: Whoever says this three times in the evening will not be harmed by anything that night.

duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ
duas.english: In the name of Allah. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from male and female evil beings.
duas.benefit: Said before entering — protects from evil jinn frequenting impure places.

duas.arabic: غُفْرَانَكَ
duas.english: I seek Your forgiveness.
duas.benefit: Said upon leaving the bathroom — gratitude for the relief Allah granted.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
duas.english: O Allah, open for me the doors of Your mercy.
duas.benefit: Said when entering the masjid with the right foot first.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You from Your bounty.
duas.benefit: Said upon leaving the masjid with the left foot first.

duas.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ
duas.english: I seek the forgiveness of Allah.
duas.benefit: Recited three times after every fard prayer.

duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ
duas.english: Glory be to Allah.
duas.benefit: Part of the Tasbih Fatimah — wipes away sins even if as much as the foam of the sea.

duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
duas.english: All praise is for Allah.
duas.benefit: Recited 33 times after every fard prayer.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
duas.english: Allah is the Greatest.
duas.benefit: Completes the Tasbih Fatimah after every fard prayer.

duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
duas.english: In the name of Allah.
duas.benefit: Said before eating — invites barakah into the meal.

duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
duas.english: All praise is for Allah who fed me this and provided it without any might or power from me.
duas.benefit: Said after eating — past sins are forgiven.

duas.arabic: بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا
duas.english: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.
duas.benefit: Said when going to sleep — places trust in Allah for the night.

duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
duas.english: Glory to Allah, all praise is to Allah, and Allah is the Greatest.
duas.benefit: Taught by the Prophet ﷺ to Fatimah and Ali — better than a servant.

duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ
duas.english: Glory to Him who has subjected this to us, and we could never have it by our efforts. Indeed, to our Lord we will return.
duas.benefit: Recited when boarding a vehicle, ship, or plane.

duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
duas.english: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.
duas.benefit: Said upon arriving at a new place — protects from harm there.
